===== setViewState =====
function setViewState(view){var s=state(),target=canonical(view);s.view=target;try{if(typeof window.__EXPORTHUB_BIND_STATE__==='function')window.__EXPORTHUB_BIND_STATE__(s);document.body.setAttribute('data-exporthub-view',target);document.body.setAttribute('data-current-view',target);if(target!=='diagnostics'){var root=document.getElementById('content');if(root){root.classList.remove('rc870-diagnostics-view','rc871-diagnostics-view');root.removeAttribute('data-rc870-diagnostics-view');root.removeAttribute('data-rc871-diagnostics-view')}}}catch(_){}return s}

===== initHistory =====
function initHistory(){if(!historyEnabled()||historyReady)return false;var v=current(),hs=window.history&&window.history.state;try{if(!hs||hs.exporthub!==true){window.history.replaceState(historyPayload(v,true),'',window.location.href);window.history.pushState(historyPayload(v,false),'',window.location.href)}else{window.history.replaceState(Object.assign({},hs,{exporthub:true,view:canonical(hs.view||v),version:version()}),'',window.location.href)}historyReady=true;return true}catch(_){return false}}

===== recordHistory =====

===== handlePopState =====
